yzi_2: Yapay Zekâ İzi: AI in 1.6M Job Ads (concept)
yzi_4: ProblemHow fast is AI really entering Turkish job ads since the GPT moment of 2022, and which tools do employers name? Keyword counts cannot tell a requirement from boilerplate across 1.6M ads written in free Turkish text.
yzi_5: ApproachAn LLM pipeline over 1.6M kariyer.net ads, from 2022 to the first half of 2026: sentence-level reading of every ad, generative AI kept apart from classic AI and machine learning, tool names normalised so mentions can be counted, and an internal analysis site, Yapay Zekâ İzi (“the trace of AI”), with periods, tools, sectors, a validation page and the method. Every quote on a card is taken from the ad verbatim.
yzi_6: ResultA clear, period-by-period picture of how fast generative AI moved from novelty to requirement in Turkish job ads, and which tools employers actually name, with every finding traceable to the sentence it came from.
yzi_8: Confidential Kariyer.net work, shown here as a concept only. No screens, data, link or product is public.
case_projectlens_2: ProjectLens: 64 hours of pricing work down to 5.5
case_projectlens_4: ProblemEvery project quote started life as a fresh Excel file. Effort estimation, pricing, proposal drafting, approval and follow-up lived in spreadsheets and inboxes. No shared history, no auditable numbers, no way to ask the data a question.
case_projectlens_5: ApproachBuilt with the Pricing & Revenue team: one tool that runs request intake → effort calculation → pricing → proposal → approval → follow-up end to end. Wired into Microsoft Teams and Azure DevOps so requests arrive where the team already works. Ships a read-only SQL console (SELECT/WITH only, every query in a rolled-back transaction on its own connection) plus a presentation mode that masks figures during screen shares.
case_projectlens_6: Result91% of the manual effort eliminated. 64h of hand work reduced to 5.5h, freeing 59 hours (7.3 working days). 31 Excel files no longer created.
case_projectlens_13: 59h freed 91% effort cut 31 Excel files avoided
case_projectlens_14: Savings modelled as 31 pricing runs × (2h − 10min) + 4 intake requests × (30min − 5min). The 2h manual baseline is a team estimate from 2026-07-30, not a measurement.
